sources.stroke_px: Outline width of HUD and label text (px). Part of the pixel box of a text line, so lines are spaced by their outlined height.
sources.line_gap_px: Clear pixels between the outlined boxes of two HUD lines. First-pass flight clips (2026-11-21) set lines 4 px apart (font size + 4) although the outlined glyphs of a 16 px font are 22 px tall.
sources.edge_margin_px: Clear pixels between the HUD block and the frame bottom edge.
sources.label_origin_px: Top-left corner of the view label (the original literal of the export loop).
sources.panel_gap_px: Clear pixels between the view label and the impact panels, which start below it so a left-hand panel cannot cover the label.
